steps.prompt: Which grammar mistake do you make most often? How do you usually catch it?

cards.title: Edit in passes
cards.body: Don’t try to catch everything at once. Read once for verbs (does each verb agree with its subject? is the tense right?), once for pronouns and tricky words (I/me, their/there, its/it’s), once for sentences (comma splices, fragments), once for capitals and commas.

cards.title: Common essay mistakes
cards.text:
Every student know → Every student knows
Tired students cannot focus, they make mistakes → …focus, so they make mistakes
Because sleep helps the brain. → …faster because sleep helps the brain.
cards.note: Agreement, a comma splice and a fragment: three mistakes that hide in essays.

cards.title: Use the Coach
cards.body: The Coach underlines verbs, pronouns, sentences and punctuation it is unsure about. It is a guide, not a rule: decide for yourself, then fix.

prompts: Which kind of mistake was hardest to spot?
Which pass will you always do from now on?
